quotes.title: Kepler-42
quotes.card: Kepler-42, formerly known as KOI-961, is a red dwarf located in the constellation Cygnus and approximately 131 light years from the Sun.
quotes.introduction: It has three known extrasolar planets, all of which are smaller than Earth in radius and orbit very close to the star.
